articles.title: Division Series Weird & Wild: Brewers, Padres kept it close, but Yankees never led Rays
articles.description: It was the last postseason quadrupleheader of 2026, and I watched every darned minute of it. Here are the highlights and lowlights.

articles.title: Start spreading the news: Victor Mesa Jr., Rays are headed to ALCS after sweeping Yankees
articles.description: Mesa was in mix during the most action-packed moments of Game 3, and he's a big reason why Tampa Bay's unselfish roster is so cohesive.

articles.title: Junior Caminero adopts familiar troll after Rays sweep New York: 'Theeee Yankees lose!'
articles.description: Caminero, whose Rays swept New York 3-0 in the ALDS, also did Stephen Curry's iconic "night night" celebration at Yankee Stadium.

articles.title: Yankees can't grab a game as they're swept away by Rays in disappointing ALDS
articles.description: An overturned homer loomed large as the Rays, perhaps the most complete team remaining, ended their rival's season in sweeping fashion.

articles.title: Anthony Volpe's tying home run in Game 3 overturned after Yankees fan interference
articles.description: What seemed like a two-run homer to tie the score in Game 3 of the ALDS was instead ruled an RBI double due to fan interference.

articles.title: The Rays’ brand of baseball is suffocating the Yankees — and New York is running out of time
articles.description: When the Yankees couldn’t get out of their own way in a pressure-packed moment, the Rays turned up the stress level. Again. And again.

articles.title: MLB Division Series results: Scores, highlights and ALDS Game 2 takeaways
articles.description: It was a sloppy day of low-scoring baseball in the ALDS, with the White Sox and Rays taking commanding 2-0 leads in their series.

articles.title: Sloppy Yankees implode in gaffe-filled Game 2 as Rays push them to the brink
articles.description: The Yankees looked shaken. They made mistake after mistake, committing four errors. Now they must win three straight games to stay alive.

articles.title: Inside Freddy Peralta's revival with Rays, from Mets disappointment to playoff starter
articles.description: How Peralta reclaimed his mojo as “Fastball Freddy” began with one pitch during his poor Rays debut — but his turnaround involves much more.

articles.title: Drew Rasmussen's Yankees mastery continues in Game 1. 'Dialed in' Rays ace looks untouchable
articles.description: Rasmussen is a pitching savant. He pours over scouting reports. He obsesses over pitch sequences.

articles.title: Rays ride Drew Rasmussen's no-hit bid to Game 1 win. Can Yankees' bats bounce back?
articles.description: Rasmussen threw 7 2/3 innings of no-hit ball and struck out 10 in a dominant performance that stymied the Yankees' offense.

articles.title: Three years after sparse crowds in playoffs, Rays draw packed house vs. Yankees
articles.description: "I've never seen it like this," Florida resident and Rays fan Ray Crawford, 43, said Saturday at Tropicana Field. "This is crazy."

articles.title: Aaron Judge not on Yankees' ALDS roster vs. Rays, but Ryan Weathers added to pen
articles.description: Judge (calf sprain) also wasn’t on the roster for the Wild Card Series vs. Boston this week. Weathers adds a new option out of the bullpen.

articles.title: Division Series predictions: Can the Yankees take down the Rays? Will the Dodgers advance?
articles.description: The Rays, Brewers and Guardians have first-round byes or home-field edges, but not everyone on the staff is buying it.

articles.title: 2026 World Series odds: Dodgers still favored, but Yankees now in top spot for AL pennant
articles.description: As the Division Series start, the Dodgers remain the clear favorites to win the World Series. The Yankees vaulted the Rays as AL favorite.

articles.title: Yankees vs. Rays ALDS predictions: Ben Rice, Cam Schlittler and the matchups that could decide the series
articles.description: Can the Yankees solve their Drew Rasmussen problem? Can the Rays keep Ben Rice from doing damage? Here's what our writers will be watching.

articles.title: For Yankees, beating top-seeded Rays should be their ticket back to World Series
articles.description: Tampa Bay should represent a much bigger obstacle than either team the Yankees could face in the ALCS, if they advance.

articles.title: World Series predictions: Will we see a Brewers-Rays showdown?
articles.description: Our MLB experts make their picks for who will make it to the World Series and who will take home the ultimate prize.

articles.title: 2026 World Series odds: Dodgers favored with Brewers, Rays, Yankees lurking
articles.description: Los Angeles has a notable edge to win its third straight championship, but three other teams are close.

articles.title: Even if Rays or Brewers win World Series, competitive balance argument will endure
articles.description: If a small-market team wins the World Series, the league will still continue its push for a salary cap.
